title: Flight Search Resource
description: Provides flight search results, prices, durations, airline details, and sorting capabilities for origin and destination queries.

supportedIntents.description: Queries requesting flights between origin and destination cities or airport codes, including pricing and flight durations.
example: flight from San Francisco to Tokyo
cheap flights from Paris to Rome

categories.description: Category of flight trip (e.g. One-way, Round-trip, Multi-city)

subtypes.description: Cabin class: Economy, Premium Economy, Business, First Class

attributes.description: Flight attributes such as price, duration, airline, stops, departureTime, arrivalTime

minMaxRange.description: Numeric range filter for price or flight duration

type.description: Kind of request: 'list' for multiple flights or 'query' for filtered flights

filters.description: Filters including origin, destination, date, stops, and price range

origin.description: Origin city or IATA airport code (e.g. NYC, DEL, SFO)

destination.description: Destination city or IATA airport code (e.g. LON, BOM, TYO)

sort.description: Sorting criteria: cheapest, fastest, best, price_desc, duration_desc
